professionalSummary.text: Three years as a Customer Success Manager at an analytics software company, managing a book of 22 mid‑market accounts and consistently delivering quarterly business reviews in the team’s format.
professionalSummary.witness: Customer success manager at an analytics software company for three years, running the quarterly business reviews for a book of twenty‑two mid‑market accounts under the team's review format.

professionalSummary.text: Presented adoption findings and recommendations to customer executives in every review, achieving survey scores at or above the team average each quarter.

professionalSummary.text: Tracked adoption against each account’s success plan using the customer success platform, with monthly reviews with the head of customer success.
professionalSummary.witness: Tracked adoption against each account's success plan in the customer success platform, with the plans reviewed monthly with the head of customer success.

professionalSummary.text: Coordinated renewals with account executives via a renewal tracker, documenting preparation responsibilities while pricing decisions remained with the account executives.
professionalSummary.witness: Coordinated renewals with the account executives through the renewal tracker; the pricing decisions were the account executives', and the tracker records which preparation was mine.

professionalSummary.text: Authored open‑items notes and hand‑over conditions for each account at quarter‑end, ensuring clear documentation of outstanding items.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the open items note and the hand-over conditions for each account at each quarter end.

experienceHighlights.text: Managed 22 mid‑market accounts, delivering 3 quarterly business reviews per account per year.
experienceHighlights.witness: running the quarterly business reviews for a book of twenty‑two mid‑market accounts
